mechanics.claim: The passive damage reduction applies to every separate instance of pre-mitigation physical damage taken, each capped individually at 50%.
mechanics.quote: reduces every instance of {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} {{as|physical damage}} taken, capped at 50% of the damage instance

mechanics.claim: A basic attack's base damage and each on-hit effect are separate damage instances, each reduced individually if physical.
mechanics.quote: A {{tip|basic attack}}'s {{tip|basic damage}} and each {{tip|on-hit}} effect are all separate damage instances, and may be reduced each if they deal {{as|physical damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Tantrum's current cooldown is reduced by 0.75s each time Amumu is hit by an on-hit basic attack effect, and this can trigger multiple times for multi-hit on-hit effects like Guinsoo's Rageblade.
mechanics.quote: ''Tantrum's'' cooldown reduction will trigger multiple times for effects such as {{ai|Double Strike|Master Yi}} and {{iis|Guinsoo's Rageblade}} ''Phantom Hit''.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown reduction still triggers even if the incoming attack is blocked, but not if it misses due to blind.
mechanics.quote: The cooldown will be reduced, even if the incoming attack is {{tip|blocked}}.
